violated_contract: An allowlisted fork seam's line budget belongs to its complete difference from upstream. The integration diff may contain upstream-authored growth and omit fork edits already present on the PR base; it cannot be used as the seam's budget measurement.
canonical_prevention: Use the PR base-to-head diff only to select files for review, then measure each selected seam directly between the upstream tree and the candidate tree. Exercise a real upstream merge that preserves an existing seam and an incremental edit that exceeds the cumulative seam budget.
